description.short_caption: Large tense bulla with discoloration on the thigh.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a large, tense bulla on the skin of the thigh. The lesion has a yellowish-brown discoloration with some areas of whitish desquamation or crusting. The surrounding skin appears erythematous but intact. The lesion is well-demarcated and appears to be fluid-filled, suggesting a possible infectious or inflammatory etiology.
